business_summary: Nissin Shoji Co.,Ltd. engages in the petroleum business in Japan. It provides biomass power generation fuel, such as palm kernel shell and empty fruit bunches pellets; energy saving solutions and marketing; lubricating and fuel oils; and service station solutions, including car wash and coating, vehicle inspection, repair, and insurance, as well as car sales, leases, and rentals. The company also offers functional chemicals, comprising synthetic resin raw, packaging, non-woven, and reflective materials; agricultural covering material; thermal shielding coated sheet for tunnels; thermal insulation material; and reflective materials under the Teru Teru, Warmth, Round Cool, and Warif brand names. In addition, it provides photosynthetic efficiency accelerator; CO2 application controller under the OCES-200S and Conductor brand names; agricultural houses, including steel frame, ap, and pipe houses; liquefied petroleum gas, such as propane and industrial gases; water heaters; built-in hob; industrial boilers; and disaster propane gas generator. Further, the company is involved in real estate leasing of office buildings and residences; new construction and acquisition of properties; and tenant management. Nissin Shoji Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
